item.title: Graphify vs. grep: Does a knowledge graph help an AI coding agent?
item.description: A measured comparison of Graphify and ordinary source search across twelve FastAPI repository questions, including time, tokens, cost, and whether the knowledge graph showed enough value to justify its overhead.

item.title: Before ChatGPT: What My Master's Thesis Taught Me About Meaning in Text
item.description: A look back at my 2021 master’s thesis on Gaussian LDA, word embeddings, and the surprisingly difficult question of whether a topic model has understood anything.
